project_type: Tauri v2 desktop app: Rust workspace (hybrid-orchestrator/crates/*) + React/TypeScript (Vite) webview (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/). Orchestrates chat providers, MCP tool servers, and a pluggable routing-policy engine.
build_system: Cargo per-crate via --manifest-path (workspace members array is EMPTY; every crate is under [workspace] exclude, so bare `cargo build`/`cargo test` build NOTHING). Frontend: npm + Vite + vitest. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs fmt/build/test/clippy per crate on ubuntu+windows plus the frontend vitest/eslint/prettier gate.
test_framework: Rust: built-in #[test]/#[tokio::test], wiremock for HTTP adapters (see gemini.rs tests). Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react; every test that mounts <App/>/chat/Settings mocks the Tauri `invoke` for ALL commands.
build_command: Per touched crate: `cargo build --manifest-path crates/<c>/Cargo.toml` (run from hybrid-orchestrator/). NOTE: providers/orchestrator-core/tauri-app may NOT fully compile in-sandbox (rustc 1.92 vs AWS-SDK deps needing >=1.94); CI is the authoritative compile gate. Frontend: `npm run build` (tsc + vite) from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/.
test_command: Per touched crate: `cargo test --manifest-path crates/<c>/Cargo.toml`. Frontend: `npm run test` (vitest) from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/.
verification_instructions: OFFLINE gates that MUST pass before declaring done (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: crates.io + npm are 403, no Tauri CLI, no live Ollama/cloud): (1) `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/<c>/Cargo.toml --check` for EVERY touched crate. (2) From hybrid-orchestrator/frontend: `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` over the WHOLE dir must be clean (global prettier 3.9.x available; clear NODE_OPTIONS; run the REAL prettier - do NOT eyeball, prettier misses have cost 2 CI rounds). (3) If node_modules is present, run `npm run test`, `npm run lint`, `tsc` (npm run build) and make them green; if npm install is impossible offline, at minimum keep TS types + every mock/fixture in sync by hand and self-audit. (4) cargo build/test/clippy where the crate compiles in-sandbox; where it does not, HAND-AUDIT every struct-literal construction site of any changed struct (e.g. a new AvailableModel field means EVERY construction + test updated) so it compiles first try in CI. Real gates run in GitHub CI after the orchestrator pushes; behavioral proof is the user's Windows build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Cargo.lock and frontend/package-lock.json are committed; package-lock.json is generated by the first networked CI run (may be absent in sandbox). Do NOT hand-edit lockfiles.
setup_instructions: Work on ONE feature branch off main (repo /projects/agent-harbor, clean at v0.9.0). From hybrid-orchestrator/frontend run `npm install` only if the registry is reachable (it is NOT under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY); otherwise rely on any pre-existing node_modules and hand-audit. Do NOT push, tag, or open a PR - the orchestrator publishes.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox: crates.io + registry.npmjs.org return 403; no Tauri CLI; no live Ollama or cloud endpoints. Cannot run cargo/npm/tauri builds against the network or hit live provider APIs. rustc 1.92 in-sandbox is BELOW the >=1.94 some AWS-SDK transitive deps need, so providers/orchestrator-core/tauri-app may not cargo-build locally - CI is the compile gate. The `routing` crate's own unit tests need no network and DO run. Adapter tests use wiremock (local mock HTTP), no live network. Prefer host-based offline validation: per-crate cargo fmt --check, whole-frontend prettier --check, and exhaustive hand-audit of construction sites.
contribution_requirements: Lockfile policy: commit lockfile changes in the same commit as dependency changes; never gitignore lockfiles (we add NO new deps here). Serde boundary types stay camelCase (#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]); any changed/added DTO field must be updated in frontend/src/types/index.ts AND every vitest mock/fixture. Do NOT skip CI hooks. Update the spec (.kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/architecture.md Section 6 routing + note enumeration filtering + pricing/quality model).
key_patterns:
ROUTING ENGINE (crates/routing) is SOUND - FEED IT SIGNAL, do not rewrite. AutoDefaultPolicy (policies/auto_default.rs) filters by hard constraints (privacy via local_provider_ids set + required capabilities) then ranks by a weighted quality-for-complexity + cost blend. quality_for_complexity() currently derives quality ONLY from Capabilities breadth + max_context, so uniform caps => identical quality for all 48 Gemini models. estimate_cost()/signals.rs read TokenPrice off AvailableModel.price; is_local_price() treats TokenPrice::ZERO as free. AvailableModel (crates/providers/src/builtins.rs) is the IPC DTO carrying providerId/model/capabilities/price - it is built in ONE place (list_available_models_with_build_errors loop) and constructed in MANY test sites across routing + orchestrator-core + tauri-app + demo tests. Adding a field to it touches ALL of them.

ROOT CAUSES: (1) COST 'free' for everything: tauri-app commands.rs `pricing_table_from_config` starts from PricingTable::new() (EMPTY) and only overlays persisted user rates - it NEVER applies PricingTable::bundled_defaults() (which already exists in builtins.rs with Gemini 1.25/5.0 etc). So on a fresh install every model resolves to TokenPrice::ZERO. (2) UNIFORM CAPS: GeminiAdapter::caps_for(model) hardcodes streaming/tools/json_mode=true and a crude model.contains() vision guess; list_models() parses only name+displayName and IGNORES supportedGenerationMethods, inputTokenLimit/outputTokenLimit. (3) NO per-model QUALITY signal beyond caps/context. (4) NO 404/deprecation handling. Note: the picker's default isLocal predicate is the ZERO-PRICE heuristic (ProviderModelPicker.tsx isFreeModel), so once cloud models get nonzero prices they correctly leave the 'Local' group; genuinely local (Ollama/LMStudio/Embedded) stay zero. local_provider_ids() in commands.rs already classifies locality by ProviderKind (never price) for the privacy gate.
relevant_files: hybrid-orchestrator/crates/providers/src/adapters/gemini.rs (caps_for + list_models: parse supportedGenerationMethods + token limits, filter non-chat, real caps)

hybrid-orchestrator/crates/providers/src/builtins.rs (AvailableModel DTO, PricingTable::bundled_defaults, list_available_models_with_build_errors loop, quality tier map + AvailableModel.quality field)
hybrid-orchestrator/crates/routing/src/signals.rs (cost/complexity signals; may add a model-quality helper)
hybrid-orchestrator/crates/routing/src/policies/auto_default.rs (quality_for_complexity: blend in the per-model quality tier)
hybrid-orchestrator/crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs (pricing_table_from_config: seed bundled_defaults then overlay; list_available_models_inner; send_message routing path; local_provider_ids)
hybrid-orchestrator/crates/orchestrator-core/src/pipeline.rs (run_turn: routing decision -> provider -> stream; 404 error surfacing; optional Auto fallback-to-next-candidate)
hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/types/index.ts (Capabilities, AvailableModel, TokenPrice, PricingConfig mirrors - add quality if AvailableModel gains it)
hybrid-orchestrator/crates/routing/src/policies/registry.rs, manual_override.rs, tests/demo_policy_extension.rs, orchestrator-core/tests/pipeline_e2e.rs (AvailableModel construction sites in tests)
directory_structure: hybrid-orchestrator/crates/{domain,orchestrator-core,providers,mcp-client,routing,persistence,secrets,tauri-app,engine} + frontend/src/{features,state,types,ipc,components}. providers/src/adapters/*.rs holds per-provider shims (gemini.rs is the translation shim). routing/src/{signals.rs,policy.rs,policies/*} holds the policy engine. tauri-app/src/commands.rs wires persistence + providers + routing into IPC commands. frontend/src/features/model-selector holds the picker.
